title: MMS - Forced Alignment: log_probs shapes problem
author: codemurt

comments.author: skanda1005
comments.body:
I am facing the same issue. Have you found any solution to this issue?

Thanks!

comments.author: codemurt
comments.body:
@skanda1005, using `pip install --pre torchaudio==2.1.0.dev20230627+cu118 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu118` instead of `pip install --pre torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu118` fixed the issue for me. 

I found this solution from [here](https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq/issues/5248).

comments.author: skanda1005
comments.body: Thanks a lot! Worked for me as well!
